info.name: quine-erp — Organization API
info.description:
Test data and assertions for every organization endpoint (register, T5a–T5e).

**Run the whole collection in order** (Collection Runner or newman). Each request stores the ids that later requests need.

**Tenant:** the real application has no tenant source yet: identity (T7) is not built and `bootstrap` is not runnable. So the tenant-scoped endpoints need the smoke runner, which reads the tenant from the `X-Smoke-Tenant` header. The production code never reads a tenant from a header. Without the runner, every tenant endpoint answers 401 `TENANT_NOT_RESOLVED`.

**Activation:** `/smoke/organizations/{id}/activate` belongs to the runner only. Setup still uses it to keep organization A independent of the real endpoint. The real activate endpoint (T5e) is tested in folder 6.

Clients must branch on `code` only. `message` is developer-facing English (T5f).

item.name: 0. Setup
item.description:
Registers two organizations (tenant A and tenant B) and activates A.

Activation uses the smoke runner's `/smoke/...` endpoint, because the real activate endpoint (T5e) is not built yet.

request.description: Runner-only endpoint. The real activate endpoint (T5e) is blocked on the product-owner decision about who activates.

item.name: 1. Register organization — POST /api/organizations
item.description: Public endpoint. It never reads a tenant: registration creates the tenant.

exec: pm.test("message is Request body is missing or malformed", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Request body is missing or malformed"));

pm.test("message is currencyCode: size must be between 3 and 3; headquartersCode: must match the required format; headquartersCode: must not be blank; headquartersName: must not be blank; headquartersName: size must be between 2 and 120; legalName: must not be blank; legalName: size must be between 2 and 160; organizationName: must not be blank; organizationName: size must be between 2 and 120", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("currencyCode: size must be between 3 and 3; headquartersCode: must match the required format; headquartersCode: must not be blank; headquartersName: must not be blank; headquartersName: size must be between 2 and 120; legalName: must not be blank; legalName: size must be between 2 and 160; organizationName: must not be blank; organizationName: size must be between 2 and 120"));

request.description: Sends Accept-Language: fr on purpose. The message must still be English (T5f).

item.name: Caller-supplied tenantId is ignored → 201 with a generated tenant

exec: pm.test("tenantId is generated, not the one sent", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().tenantId).to.not.eql("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"));

item.name: 2. Add store (T5a) — POST /api/organizations/{id}/stores
item.description: 201 on success. There is no Location header and no tenantId.

exec: pm.test("message is storeCode: must match the required format", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("storeCode: must match the required format"));

pm.test("message is storeName: must not be blank; storeName: size must be between 2 and 120", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("storeName: must not be blank; storeName: size must be between 2 and 120"));
pm.test("message is id: must be a valid UUID", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("id: must be a valid UUID"));

item.name: 3. Change headquarters (T5b) — PUT /api/organizations/{id}/headquarters
item.description: 200 on success. A repeat returns 409 STORE_IS_ALREADY_HEADQUARTERS.

exec: pm.test("message is storeId: must not be null", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("storeId: must not be null"));
pm.test("message is Request body is missing or malformed", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Request body is missing or malformed"));

item.name: Other tenant with a real store id → 404
4. Deactivate store (T5c) — POST /api/organizations/{id}/stores/{storeId}/deactivation
item.description: There is no request body. 200 on success.

exec: pm.test("message is storeId: must be a valid UUID", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("storeId: must be a valid UUID"));

item.name: Other tenant with a real store id → 404
5. Close organization (T5d) — POST /api/organizations/{id}/closure
item.description: There is no request body. The tenant closes, with no confirmation step (PO 2026-09-28). Closing is irreversible.

item.name: 6. Activate organization (T5e) — POST /api/organizations/{id}/activation
item.description: There is no request body. The tenant activates its own organization (PO 2026-10-01). Only PENDING_ACTIVATION can be activated. Runs last: organization B is still PENDING here, and A is CLOSED.

exec: pm.test("message names the parameter", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("id: must be a valid UUID"));

item.name: Add store to B after activation → 201
